props.title: Deploy your first function in two commands
props.description: Link a project, deploy it, and curl the domain the CLI hands back. Builds run on your machine with --local, or on Azion.
props.session:
azion link --preset javascript --name auth-handler --auto
# Project successfully configured

azion deploy --auto
# Upload completed successfully!
# Your Application was deployed successfully
# Domain: https://k7q2fmx4ze.map.azionedge.net

curl https://k7q2fmx4ze.map.azionedge.net/
# Hello World
